segments.t: Welcome to Season Six of Kukhnya! Today Hotel Eleon is hosting the lavish wedding of owner Eleonora Andreyevna and showman Dmitry Nagiyev, and Eleonora is already grilling restaurant director Ilya over the VIP seating plan.
За нашим столиком будет сидеть олигарх.
Подождите, у нас столик на четверых.
Вы у нас директор ресторана, Илья.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
За нашим столиком будет сидеть олигарх.
'An oligarch will be sitting at our table.' Notice how Russian puts 'table' and 'oligarch' together in a short, direct phrase where word endings show how the ideas connect.
'They called and will definitely come.' The meaning hinges on 'they' working together with 'will come' in spoken Russian.
Подождите, у нас столик на четверых.
'Wait, our table is for four.' Russians say 'by me' or 'with us' where English says 'I have' or 'we have', without needing a separate word for 'have'.
'And you end up with six people.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'six people'.
'You tell me how to do it.' Notice how Russian puts 'say' and 'how' together in a short, direct phrase where word endings show how the ideas connect.
Вы у нас директор ресторана, Илья.
'You are our restaurant director, Ilya.' Russians say 'by me' or 'with us' where English says 'I have' or 'we have', without needing a separate word for 'have'.
'Yes, alright.' In spoken Russian, a compact phrase like this carries the full meaning through tone and context.
'Eleonora Andreyevna, sorry to interrupt.' Ilya brings out the contrast between 'Eleonora' and 'excuse me' in a few short words.
'Here, they brought your dress.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'here' and finishing on 'a dress'.
'And Dmitry Vladimirovich's tailcoat.' Ilya centers this short reply on 'tailcoat', letting a few direct words carry the whole meaning.
'Let's go through the wedding script.' The meaning hinges on 'let's' working together with 'wedding' in spoken Russian.
'Make it faster, okay?' Eleonora raises the pitch on 'yes' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
За нашим столиком будет сидеть олигарх.
Подождите, у нас столик на четверых.
Вы у нас директор ресторана, Илья.
With the wedding dress delivered and the VIP table overcrowded, the pressure on the hotel staff is already sky-high. Until next time!
